products.name: Nike Jordan 1 low Travis Scott mocha-j1ltramom
products.tags: shoes,Nike Jordan 1 low Travis Scott mocha-j1ltramom,Jordan 1 low Travis Scott mocha
products.description: The Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Low 'Mocha' is the result of a collaboration between Jordan Brand and Travis Scott. The shoe's nubuck upper construction appears in black and dark mocha, accented by University Red hits. The standout feature is the Swoosh on the lateral side, which has a rearward application. A standard Swoosh appears on the medial side, while the tongue, medial quarter panel, and sock liner feature Cactus Jack branding. The heels feature a "Wings" logo on the right shoe and Scott's crudely drawn face on the left to complete the collaborative look.

products.name: Nike InfinityRN 4 GORE-TEX Black-(super lightweight and Super comfortable)-(Made in vietnam)-nrgb1:1
products.description: With supportive cushioning built for a smooth run, the Nike InfinityRN 4 is a brand-new take on a familiar favourite. It's made from our all-new Nike ReactX foam, which gives you 13% more energy return compared to Nike React foam, to help you stay fresh and bouncy. (What's more? Nike ReactX reduces its carbon footprint in a pair of midsoles by at least 43% compared with Nike React foam.*) This version has GORE-TEX fabric to help you stay dry for your miles. It's the kind of shoe that supports every step in style. *The carbon footprint of ReactX is based on a cradle-to-gate assessment reviewed by PRé Sustainability B.V. and Intertek China. Other midsole components such as airbags, plates or other foam formulations were not considered.

products.name: Adidas Campus 00s Gray - ADcamash1.1
products.description:
CAMPUS SHOES THAT EVOLVE THE LEGACY.

Although they made their debut on the hardwood, the adidas Campus shoes were quickly adopted just about everywhere else. With this pair, we move the iconic silhouette in another direction and add modern materials, colors and proportions. They're done with a premium leather upper lined with soft textile terry fabric, with all of it riding on an off-white midsole — a clear connect to the Campus legacy.

products.tags: NIKE ZOOM X WATER SHELL Blue
products.description:
The shoe is made in a design that is suitable for runners. The Zoom Air Cushioning installed in the forefoot frants immense energy return, to give it a strike with every stride. The black Upper is breathable with perforation at the midfoot and forefoot.

Nike have implimented a crash pad placed at the heel to deliver an extra cushioned barrier, granting smoother heel-to-toe transitions for an unbeatable, responsive ride. They have White rubber made sole for durability and Flexibility.

Specification

Brand: Nike
Breathable mesh upper with reflective details
Cage system in the midfoot area with a reinforced eyelet strip offers a secure hold over the midsole
The continuous rubber sole protects the foot from below
Upper: Synthetic & textile
Sole: Rubber

products.name: Adidas Marathon super lightweight and comfortable (White blue)
products.description:
Whether you're training for a marathon or just trying to stay in shape, adidas has an array of men's running shoes designed to take your performance up a couple of notches. Our selection of men's running sneakers includes lightweight, cushioned styles for road running as well as durable, grippy shoes built for trail running over uneven terrain. Technologies like adidas Boost, adidas Bounce and Lightstrike provide exceptional energy return and flexible and lightweight cushioning to reduce fatigue over long distances. Breathable mesh uppers keep your feet cool mile after mile. From racing flats for speed training to plush daily trainers, we have men's running shoes for runners of all levels.

With styles designed for stability, climate control and comfort, our collection of running shoes for men will have you ready to run faster and farther. From performance road running shoes to trail shoes that can handle any terrain, adidas builds innovative men's running sneakers to help you achieve your goals. Whether you're training for your first 5K or going for a new PR, adidas men's running shoes provide the comfort, durability and tech to help you own the run. Explore our collection and find the running shoes that will help unleash your potential.

From performance road running shoes to trail shoes that can handle any terrain, adidas builds innovative men's running sneakers to help you achieve your goals. Whether you're training for your first 5K or going for a new PR, adidas men's running shoes provide the comfort, durability and tech to help you own the run. Explore our collection and find the running shoes that will help unleash your potential.

products.description:
The NOVABLAST 4 running shoe features a new midsole and outsole geometry that helps produce an energized ride.

A tongue wing construction in the upper helps improve the fit while reducing tongue movement. It's complemented with an engineered woven upper that offers more stretch, ventilation, and durability.

FF BLAST PLUS ECO cushioning is made with 20% recycled bio-based content. This material helps create softer landings and a more energized toe-off during your training.

products.name: ASICS Gel Kayano 30 Black Glow Yellow-asgk30bk
products.tags: ASICS Gel Kayano 30 Black Glow Yellow
products.description:
ASICS is committed to creating products that feel best for both body and mind. The combination of rigorous user testing, biomechanical science, sustainability, and decades of continuous improvement has enabled the development of new and innovative products and technologies, including the new GEL-KAYANO™ 30 shoe and its unique 4D GUIDANCE SYSTEM™. 

The 4D GUIDANCE SYSTEM™ works with the movement of the body to provide adaptive stability and enhanced support when runners need it most. The first three dimensions are no strangers to stability shoes: width, length, and depth. The unique addition of the fourth dimension, time, has enabled ASICS to reduce the amount of time spent in (over)pronation, resulting in a better supported and more comfortable run.

The artist’s signature ‘XX,’ also juxtaposed above Nike’s ‘AIR’ trademark, and are inscribed on the heels to create a fusion style to this triple black kick. products.name: Jordan 4 Retro PSG Paris Saint-Germain-j4pam
products.description:
Jordan Brand and French professional football club Paris Saint Germain expanded their collaboration into 2020 with the Jordan 4 PSG. The two entities have collaborated on the Jordan 5, Jordan 6, and Jordan 1 silhouettes in the past.

The Jordan 4 PSG features traditional color-blocking that is reminiscent of the classic Fire Red 4. White leather comprises the upper while grey nubuck paneling encompasses the toe wrap. Bordeaux purple and black coat the signature rubber wings, lace cages, and midsole. Finishing details include a "PANAME" text label on the lateral forefoot concluded with a "PSG" badge on the rubber heel tab.

products.name: Jordan 4 Retro Off-White Sail-j4ow1.1
products.description: Jordan Brand and Virgil Abloh teamed up once again to release the third silhouette in their collaborative history with the women's Jordan 4 Retro Off-White Sail (W), now available on StockX. After teasing the release of the Off-White 4 with samples in his MCA exhibit and presenting them in his Off-White FW2020 Women’s Show, Virgil Abloh finally delivered what might be the most anticipated release of 2020. The Air Jordan 4 Sail features full-grain leather uppers with hits of mesh and translucent materials on the toebox and heel of the shoe. From there, hits of light blue on the tongue’s Jumpman and the outsole’s Nike Swoosh provide contrast to the sail colored sneaker.

products.name: Jordan 4 Retro Military Black-j4mbk1.1
products.description:
Jordan Brand flipped one of its original Air Jordan 4 colorways for the Air Jordan 4 Military Black.

Pulling its color-blocked style from the Air Jordan 4 Military Blue, the Air Jordan 4 Military Black features a smooth white leather upper with a light grey Durabuck toe wrap and netted TPU inserts. products.name: New Balance Fresh Foam X 1080 v13 Super Comfortable Shoes(Black)
products.tags: New Balance Fresh Foam X 1080 v13 Super Comfortable Shoes
products.description:
When first taking this shoe out of the box, I couldn’t help but notice how light it felt even though there was a fairly thick midsole.

When I first put it on my feet, it really felt like I was walking on clouds. My first run in the shoe was a fartlek workout. I felt like I was bouncing during the faster parts of the run while gliding comfortably during my easier parts of the run.

The shoe handles high mileage with ease and is also a great recovery shoe. I used this shoe on my first few runs post-marathon and my legs were thankful for the soft ride.

The construction of the upper on this shoe is great.

The tongue and heel collar feel very soft and neither created any issues with hot spots or blisters for me. The tongue is gusseted (i.e. attached) and the heel collar is padded.

The laces were fine and never came undone when tied with a single knot. The whole upper is made of a soft knit mesh that is very breathable yet can handle some of the colder air. The shoe fit true to size for me with plenty of room in the toe box without making it too roomy.

Our selection of men's running sneakers includes lightweight, cushioned styles for road running as well as durable, grippy shoes built for trail running over uneven terrain. Technologies like adidas Boost, adidas Bounce and Lightstrike provide exceptional energy return and flexible and lightweight cushioning to reduce fatigue over long distances. Breathable mesh uppers keep your feet cool mile after mile. From racing flats for speed training to plush daily trainers, we have men's running shoes for runners of all levels.

With styles designed for stability, climate control and comfort, our collection of running shoes for men will have you ready to run faster and farther. From performance road running shoes to trail shoes that can handle any terrain, adidas builds innovative men's running sneakers to help you achieve your goals. Whether you're training for your first 5K or going for a new PR, adidas men's running shoes provide the comfort, durability and tech to help you own the run. Explore our collection and find the running shoes that will help unleash your potential.

products.name: Asics NOVABLAST 4 PLATINUM (ROSE GOLD)-(made in indonesia)asnoba5bl
products.description:
The NOVABLAST 4 PLATINUM running shoe features midsole and outsole geometry that helps produce an energized ride.

A tongue wing construction in the upper helps improve the fit while reducing tongue movement.

It's complemented with an engineered woven upper that offers more stretch, ventilation, and durability.

FF BLAST PLUS ECO cushioning is made with approximately 24% bio-based content.

This material helps create softer landings and a more energized toe-off during your training.

products.name: ASICS GEL-NIMBUS 25 (Lite Blue) asgelcompe
products.description:
The GEL-NIMBUS™ 25 running shoe is designed to provide you with the most comfortable running experience so you can reach your moment of calm. Thanks to its maximum cushioning, you can run further in total comfort. And it's runner tested and approved. In fact, it was chosen by runners as the most comfortable running shoe in an independent test at a biomechanics lab in South Australia.

The shoe's pairing of our new PureGEL™ technology and soft FF BLAST™ PLUS ECO foam means you’ll experience incredible comfort each time you want to run even further. Plus, its updated upper and collar construction provides an unrivalled comfortable fit and feel.

products.name: Adidas Campus 00s Green- adcamgree
products.description:
CAMPUS SHOES THAT EVOLVE THE LEGACY.

Although they made their debut on the hardwood, the adidas Campus shoes were quickly adopted just about everywhere else. With this pair, we move the iconic silhouette in another direction and add modern materials, colors and proportions. They're done with a premium leather upper lined with soft textile terry fabric, with all of it riding on an off-white midsole — a clear connect to the Campus legacy.

products.name: ASICS NOVAVLAST 4  BLACK/CHAMPAGNE-(made in indonesia)-asnovabl4
products.description:
The NOVABLAST 4 running shoe features a new midsole and outsole geometry that helps produce an energized ride.

A tongue wing construction in the upper helps improve the fit while reducing tongue movement. It's complemented with an engineered woven upper that offers more stretch, ventilation, and durability.

FF BLAST PLUS ECO cushioning is made with 20% recycled bio-based content. This material helps create softer landings and a more energized toe-off during your training.

products.name: Adidas Adizero EVO SL Shoes (super lightweight and Super comfortable) (Grey)
products.tags: Adidas Adizero EVO SL Shoes (super lightweight and Super comfortable) (Grey)
products.description:
SPEED-INSPIRED SHOES DESIGNED FOR FAST CULTURE

Experience the feeling of fast in the Adizero Evo SL. Inspired by the innovation of record-breaking shoes in the Adizero running family - and specifically the Pro Evo 1 - the Evo SL is designed for you to run in it, or not. Combining Adizero technology with a bold and unique racing-inspired aesthetic, it's an evolution of speed in all aspects of life. A responsive layer of LIGHTSTRIKE PRO foam in the midsole provides comfort and cushioning for optimal energy return.

products.name: Adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 Yellow-SUPER Soft and comfortable
products.description: The upper is made of comfortable and breathable mesh with a LIGHTLOCK system that wraps the foot naturally and reliably. The midsole, extremely responsive and cushioned, has been updated with an optimized rocker that improves the ride and makes the stride smoother. The two layers of full-length Lightstrike PRO compound work together with the EnergyRODS 2.0 system, five anatomically designed carbon rods that run from the midfoot to the toe for unprecedented propulsion. Outsole with LIGHTTRAXION tread with Continental rubber that allows you to always maintain excellent grip with the ground.

Outsole with LIGHTTRAXION tread with Continental rubber that allows you to always maintain excellent grip with the ground.

A responsive layer of LIGHTSTRIKE PRO foam in the midsole provides comfort and cushioning for optimal energy return.

products.name: Adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 (Core Black / Matte Silver / Glory Green)SUPER Soft and comfortable
products.tags: Adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 (Core Black / Matte Silver / Glory Green)
products.description:
Adizero Adios Pro 4 Shoes
LIGHTWEIGHT DISTANCE RUNNING SHOES DESIGNED TO BREAK RECORDS
Proven to be the world's most winning shoe, the Adizero Adios Pro line is the pinnacle of Adizero Racing shoes. The Adios Pro 4 is made for fast runners who want to experience faster, with enhanced features designed to optimize running efficiency. Our carbon-infused ENERGYRODS 2.0 provide a seamless transition from heel to toe for a snappy, efficient stride. In the midsole, a new rocker point offers improved running economy. A double layer of our best-in-class ultralight LIGHTSTRIKE PRO ensures cushioning for every quick stride you take, helping you maintain energy over the long term. The shoe rides on an outsole built with Continental™ rubber for a no-slip transition during toe-off, as well as LIGHTTRAXION, designed to reduce weight without sacrificing grip.

The GEL-NIMBUS® 27 shoe's soft cushioning properties help you feel like you're landing on clouds. This design is revamped to help create a softer and smoother running experience.

A soft engineered jacquard mesh upper comfortably wraps your foot while supplying advanced ventilation. Additionally, the knit tongue and collar help provide a soft and supportive feel.

By using FF BLAST™ PLUS cushioning, this trainer creates a lighter and softer cushioning experience.

Lastly, HYBRID ASICSGRIP™ outsole rubber helps create better traction, improved softness, and advanced durability.

products.name: New Balance Fresh Foam X 1080 v13 Super Comfortable Shoes(Lite blue)
products.tags: New Balance Fresh Foam X 1080 v13 Super Comfortable Shoes
products.description:
When first taking this shoe out of the box, I couldn’t help but notice how light it felt even though there was a fairly thick midsole.

When I first put it on my feet, it really felt like I was walking on clouds. My first run in the shoe was a fartlek workout. I felt like I was bouncing during the faster parts of the run while gliding comfortably during my easier parts of the run.

The shoe handles high mileage with ease and is also a great recovery shoe. I used this shoe on my first few runs post-marathon and my legs were thankful for the soft ride.

The construction of the upper on this shoe is great.

The tongue and heel collar feel very soft and neither created any issues with hot spots or blisters for me. The tongue is gusseted (i.e. attached) and the heel collar is padded.

The laces were fine and never came undone when tied with a single knot. The whole upper is made of a soft knit mesh that is very breathable yet can handle some of the colder air. The shoe fit true to size for me with plenty of room in the toe box without making it too roomy.

products.name: Adidas Adizero Boston 13 -(Flash Aqua / Cloud White / Lucid Lemon)adb13pe
products.tags: Adidas Adizero Boston 13 -(Flash Aqua / Cloud White / Lucid Lemon)
products.description:
Lightweight running shoes for speed training and race prep.

Tune into your fastest self with the lightweight, responsive performance of the adidas Adizero Boston 13 running shoes. Designed for the intense training sessions leading up to race day, they let you comfortably push the pace with a breathable mesh upper and secure midfoot lockdown. The Lightstrike and Lightstrike Pro midsole with ENERGYRODS provides snappy return kilometre after kilometre. A Lighttraxion outsole adds all-purpose traction while Continental™ Rubber at the toe adds no-slip toe-off.

products.name: ASICS GEL-KINSEI MAX- (French Blue/Bright Orange)-askinsdibl
products.description:
The GEL-KINSEI® MAX trainer takes the experience of running on clouds to the next level. It's been redesigned for runners who want every step to feel like it's oozing with softness.​

The tooling is modified with our FF BLAST™ PLUS cushioning for the midsole's top layer. This helps provide cloud-like comfort while creating an energized feel at toe-off. ​

A TPU midsole plate is positioned in the center of the midsole to provide a more dynamic toe-off. It also works in tandem with the new rubber foaming and Hybrid GEL® technology to help create smoother underfoot transitions.

products.name: Adidas Campus 00s brown - adcamgrme
products.description:
CAMPUS SHOES THAT EVOLVE THE LEGACY.

Although they made their debut on the hardwood, the adidas Campus shoes were quickly adopted just about everywhere else. With this pair, we move the iconic silhouette in another direction and add modern materials, colors and proportions. They're done with a premium leather upper lined with soft textile terry fabric, with all of it riding on an off-white midsole — a clear connect to the Campus legacy.

products.name: Adidas Marathon V2 super lightweight and comfortable (Black White)
products.description:
Whether you're training for a marathon or just trying to stay in shape, adidas has an array of men's running shoes designed to take your performance up a couple of notches. Our selection of men's running sneakers includes lightweight, cushioned styles for road running as well as durable, grippy shoes built for trail running over uneven terrain. Technologies like adidas Boost, adidas Bounce and Lightstrike provide exceptional energy return and flexible and lightweight cushioning to reduce fatigue over long distances. Breathable mesh uppers keep your feet cool mile after mile. From racing flats for speed training to plush daily trainers, we have men's running shoes for runners of all levels.

With styles designed for stability, climate control and comfort, our collection of running shoes for men will have you ready to run faster and farther. From performance road running shoes to trail shoes that can handle any terrain, adidas builds innovative men's running sneakers to help you achieve your goals. Whether you're training for your first 5K or going for a new PR, adidas men's running shoes provide the comfort, durability and tech to help you own the run. Explore our collection and find the running shoes that will help unleash your potential.

products.name: ON CLOUD Cloudboom Strike-(White | Black) -onclgrecol
products.description:
Cushioned Bounceboard

Made using ultra-responsive Helion™ HF hyper foam, the shoe’s innovative Bounceboard construction propels you forward with power. A removable layer of plush cushioning, it maximizes energy return for a bouncy feeling underfoot – all while abiding by stack height regulations. A cushioned ride, ideal for long races.

Carbon fiber Speedboard®

The stiff, spoon-shaped Speedboard® works like a spring, absorbing energy and transferring it into the forefoot for the most powerful take-offs possible. And strategically-placed CloudTec® elements create a faster, smoother roll-through. The result? Increased running efficiency.

Ultralight upper

Ultralight and breathable, the one-piece, semi-transparent mesh upper helps to reduce overheating. The cage-like construction locks down the midfoot for a secure, race-ready fit.

products.name: Adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 (Chalk White / Grey Strata / Impact Orange)SUPER Soft and comfortable
products.tags: Adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 (Chalk White / Grey Strata / Impact Orange)
products.description: The upper is made of comfortable and breathable mesh with a LIGHTLOCK system that wraps the foot naturally and reliably. The midsole, extremely responsive and cushioned, has been updated with an optimized rocker that improves the ride and makes the stride smoother. The two layers of full-length Lightstrike PRO compound work together with the EnergyRODS 2.0 system, five anatomically designed carbon rods that run from the midfoot to the toe for unprecedented propulsion. Outsole with LIGHTTRAXION tread with Continental rubber that allows you to always maintain excellent grip with the ground.

products.name: Nike Vomero Plus-(White bl)-(super lightweight and Super comfortable)-(Made in vietnam)-nkvplbl
products.description:
A tall stack of responsive, light foam offers next-level cushioning.

Take maximum cushioning to the next level with the Vomero Plus. It provides an ultra-comfortable ride for everyday runs thanks to a mountainous stack of full-length ZoomX foam, the most responsive foam in the industry. Plus, the engineered mesh upper is made from soft, breathable yarn for a comfortable fit.

ZoomX foam midsole

The ultra-responsive ZoomX foam midsole delivers Nike's highest energy return.

Soft upper

An engineered mesh upper provides soft breathability.

Durable traction

The high-abrasion rubber outsole offers durable traction.

Product details

  • Weight: approx. 273g (Men's size 9)
  • Heel-to-toe drop: 10mm
  • Webbed lace loops for an adjustable fit
  • Reflective design details
  • Not intended for use as personal protective equipment (PPE)
  • Colour Shown: Black/Cool Grey/Metallic Dark Grey/White
  • Style: IH3251-001

products.name: Asics SUPERBLAST 2-Lake Grey/White Sage-Soft and comfortable (Made in Vietnam)-assb2cr
products.description:
Move from feeling standard to super in the SUPERBLAST™ 2 shoe. It's designed to help provide the most responsive, energized feel compared to other shoes in the ASICS® cushioning range.​

The midsole features a combination of FF BLAST™ PLUS and FF TURBO™ PLUS cushioning. Also used in our METASPEED™ racing models, this foam helps creates one of the lightest and bounciest running experiences.

This shoe's upper construction features an asymmetric mesh design. It features different colors on the medial and lateral angles of the shoe for visual interest.​

products.name: Hoka Men's Challenger 8-Truffle Salt / Mint White-Soft and comfortable (Made in Vietnam)-hkc8gr
products.tags: Hoka Men's Challenger 8-Truffle Salt / Mint White
products.description:
The Challenger’s previous nickname “ATR” stands for All Terrain – and these really are incredibly versatile shoes. As is typical for Hoka, the Challenger also features generous cushioning. On the brand’s own cushioning scale, this model is rated as medium. The Challenger performs well on almost any surface,including hard ground. It’s a shoe that nearly every runner can make use of!

The Challenger is also easy to recommend for walking and light hiking in relatively easy terrain.

Compared to version 7, this 8th edition has a larger drop (8 mm, previously 5 mm) and a grippier outsole pattern.

products.name: Nike zoomX Pegasus 38 premium-Electric Green/Sea Greeny Blue-soft and comfortable (Made in Vietnam)-nkzxprwh
products.tags: Nike zoomX Pegasus 38 premium-Electric Green/Sea Greeny Blue
products.description:
• Midsole: It incorporates Nike's lightest and most responsive ZoomX foam, a Pebax-based compound that delivers exceptional energy return. There is a full-length carbon-fiber plate embedded within the midsole, which provides a propulsive, springy sensation to help push the pace. 
  • Upper: The upper is made from a material called VaporWeave (or engineered mesh in newer versions), which is a lightweight, water-resistant, and highly breathable synthetic fabric designed to be soft and conform to the foot. 
  • Design: The shoe features an offset lacing system to reduce pressure on the top of the foot, a wider toe area for a roomier fit, and increased foam underfoot compared to earlier models. The design is focused on minimizing weight while maximizing performance and comfort for distances from 10K to the marathon.

products.name: Asics SUPERBLAST 2-Winter Sea/White-Soft and comfortable (Made in Vietnam)-assb2bl

products.description:
Move from feeling standard to super in the SUPERBLAST™ 2 shoe. It's designed to help provide the most responsive, energized feel compared to other shoes in the ASICS® cushioning range.​

products.name: Air Jordan MVP 92-Olive/Khaki/University Red/Black-(super lightweight and Super comfortable)-(Made in vietnam)-nkaj6v2olv
products.description: The Air Jordan MVP 92 "Medium Olive" is a contemporary hybrid sneaker that pays homage to Michael Jordan’s championship legacy by blending design elements from the Air Jordan 7 into a refined low-top silhouette [1, 5]. The upper features a tactical aesthetic, utilizing a mix of Medium Olive nubuck and synthetic leather overlays paired with breathable textile panels for durability and structure [1, 5, 6]. Strategic accents of University Red on the tongue branding and heel pull tab provide a sharp contrast against the earthy tones, while a Khaki and Sail midsole incorporates visible Nike Air technology for lightweight cushioning [5, 6, 8]. This model serves as a modern lifestyle interpretation of a performance classic, offering a versatile look that bridges the gap between heritage basketball design and current streetwear trends [1, 2].

products.name: Adidas HYPERBOOST EDGE Running Shoes-Cloud White / Equipment Blue / Zero Metalic-(super lightweight and Super comfortable)-(Made in vietnam)-adcomwhbl
products.tags: HYPERBOOST EDGE Running Shoes-Cloud White / Equipment Blue / Zero Metalic
products.description:
Running shoes with a HyperBoost Pro midsole for comfort & energy on your run.

Hyperboost Edge introduces a new era of road running by combining maximum cushioning, high energy return and lightweight performance in one shoe. The shoe combines three breakthrough technologies: the new Hyperboost Pro midsole, a PRIMEWEAVE upper and a LIGHTTRAXION outsole to balance comfort and responsiveness in every stride. Crafted with no plates or stiffening elements, a new foam works naturally through the gait cycle creating a lightweight and propulsive ride. At the heart of this new running experience is the Hyperboost Pro foam, a high-performance material that provides maximum cushioning, with no compromises. Drawing on adidas’ elite racing midsole technologies, the new foam formulation delivers an experience optimized for every type of run, from daily sessions to high mileage training.

  • Mind Technology: The outsole features 22 individually articulated foam nodes that move up and down as you walk. These nodes are designed to stimulate sensory areas of the brain by translating the texture of the ground to your feet.
  • Upper Construction: The shoe has a breathable knit upper with engineered perforations. It often features a stretchy fabric footbed to allow the nodes below maximum movement while maintaining comfort against the foot.
  • Cushioning: A soft foam midsole provides robust cushioning for everyday wear.
  • Aesthetics: It features a modern, futuristic design with a minimal but aggressive look.

products.tags: Adidas HYPERBOOST EDGE Running Shoes-Cloud White / Pure Ruby / Zero Metalic
products.description:
Running shoes with a HyperBoost Pro midsole for comfort & energy on your run.

Hyperboost Edge introduces a new era of road running by combining maximum cushioning, high energy return and lightweight performance in one shoe. The shoe combines three breakthrough technologies: the new Hyperboost Pro midsole, a PRIMEWEAVE upper and a LIGHTTRAXION outsole to balance comfort and responsiveness in every stride. Crafted with no plates or stiffening elements, a new foam works naturally through the gait cycle creating a lightweight and propulsive ride. At the heart of this new running experience is the Hyperboost Pro foam, a high-performance material that provides maximum cushioning, with no compromises. Drawing on adidas’ elite racing midsole technologies, the new foam formulation delivers an experience optimized for every type of run, from daily sessions to high mileage training.

products.name: Hoka One One Speedgoat 7-Black / Stellar Grey-(super lightweight and Super comfortable)-(Made in vietnam)-hksg7
products.tags: Hoka One One Speedgoat 7-Black / Stellar Grey
products.description:
The Hoka Speedgoat 7 men's shoe offers impeccable grip and lasting comfort to confidently tackle your trail outings, from smooth paths to the most demanding courses.

Speedgoat 7 by Hoka: for which type of athlete, what use, what distance, and surface?

Versatile and reliable, the Hoka Speedgoat 7 shoe is aimed at all trail runners, from the regular to the advanced, seeking safety, stability, and performance.

It excels over medium and long distances and adapts perfectly to technical, muddy, greasy, or rocky terrains where grip and protection are essential.

Its outsole equipped with 5 mm lugs ensures effective traction to remain confident uphill and downhill, even when conditions become unstable or slippery.

Designed for varied courses, this model is an excellent option for athletes looking for a versatile trail shoe, prioritizing traction and long-lasting comfort.

+ Combining cushioning, grip, and protection, it is ideal for meeting your challenges on technical and demanding trails during long outings or ultra-trails.

The Hoka Speedgoat 7 men's shoe offers impeccable grip and lasting comfort to confidently tackle your trail outings, from smooth paths to the most demanding courses.

Speedgoat 7 by Hoka: for which type of athlete, what use, what distance, and surface?

Versatile and reliable, the Hoka Speedgoat 7 shoe is aimed at all trail runners, from the regular to the advanced, seeking safety, stability, and performance.

It excels over medium and long distances and adapts perfectly to technical, muddy, greasy, or rocky terrains where grip and protection are essential.

Its outsole equipped with 5 mm lugs ensures effective traction to remain confident uphill and downhill, even when conditions become unstable or slippery.

Designed for varied courses, this model is an excellent option for athletes looking for a versatile trail shoe, prioritizing traction and long-lasting comfort.

products.name: Hoka One One Speedgoat 7-Black / White-(super lightweight and Super comfortable)-(Made in vietnam)-hksg7bkwh
products.description:
The Hoka Speedgoat 7 men's shoe offers impeccable grip and lasting comfort to confidently tackle your trail outings, from smooth paths to the most demanding courses.

Speedgoat 7 by Hoka: for which type of athlete, what use, what distance, and surface?

Versatile and reliable, the Hoka Speedgoat 7 shoe is aimed at all trail runners, from the regular to the advanced, seeking safety, stability, and performance.

It excels over medium and long distances and adapts perfectly to technical, muddy, greasy, or rocky terrains where grip and protection are essential.

Its outsole equipped with 5 mm lugs ensures effective traction to remain confident uphill and downhill, even when conditions become unstable or slippery.

Designed for varied courses, this model is an excellent option for athletes looking for a versatile trail shoe, prioritizing traction and long-lasting comfort.

+ Combining cushioning, grip, and protection, it is ideal for meeting your challenges on technical and demanding trails during long outings or ultra-trails.

- For road outings, a dedicated model like the Hoka Clifton 10 will be more suitable.

products.name: The North Face Summit VECTIV™ Pro 3- White Ash/Sulphur Spring Green-(super lightweight and Super comfortable)-(Made in vietnam)-tnfwhop
products.tags: The North Face Summit VECTIV™ Pro 3- White Ash/Sulphur Spring Green
products.description: Designed in collaboration with The North Face® global athlete team, the Summit VECTIV™ Pro 3 Trail Running Shoes are engineered to deliver uncompromising top-level performance during ultra races on single-track trail. So much so, they've graced the podium at some of the most competitive trail races in the world. The VECTIV™ 3.0 stacked-plate system features a full-length carbon-fibre propulsion plate integrated with a TPU stability top plate to deliver high-level propulsion and stability on varied trail terrain. Super-high-rebound DREAM foam helps propel you towards the finish line, while the seamless, breathable upper is supportive, hydrophobic and quick-drying. And the super-grippy, trail-optimised SURFACE CTRL™ rubber outsole and rockered midsole geometry guarantee reliable grip on all surfaces.

products.name: Adidas Supernova Rise 3 Gore-Tex-Cloud White / Core Black / Solar Orange-(super lightweight and Super comfortable)-(Made in vietnam)-adpreofwh
products.tags: Adidas Supernova Rise 3 Gore-Tex-Cloud White / Core Black / Solar Orange
products.description:
• Upper: Clean Cloud White mesh synthetic material, stamped with a small gray GORE-TEX script on the lateral forefoot.
  • Branding: The iconic Adidas Three Stripes are rendered in an iridescent, reflective Metallic Silver-Gray.
  • Midsole & Collar:
    Deep Core Black textured foam midsole paired with a matching black tongue, laces, and heavily cushioned ankle collar.
  • Accents: Striking hits of Solar Orange pop on the tongue logo, the front toe bumper wrap, and the bottom outsole traction plate.
⚙️ Technical Design Elements

  • Dual-Foam Cushioning: The massive, stacked black midsole features a dual-layer build, clearly labeled LIGHTSTRIKE PRO on the lateral heel, signaling premium energy return usually reserved for elite racing models.
  • Textured Tooling: The midsole has a prominent wavy groove cutout line running along the flank to help stabilize the high-stack foam.
  • Weatherproof Construction: A fully gusseted design engineered with a waterproof membrane to block rain, puddles, and debris while driving moisture out.

products.name: New Balance SuperComp Rebel- Satsuma Orange / Lilac-Orange-(super lightweight and Super comfortable)-(Made in vietnam)-nbnbn2
products.tags: New Balance SuperComp Rebel- Satsuma Orange / Lilac-Orange
products.description: The New Balance SuperComp Rebel is an ultra-lightweight everyday training shoe built for runners who want a competitive, energized feel on any run — not just race day. Infinion foam delivers enhanced cushioning with energy return, while a precision-engineered propulsion plate works alongside a specialized midsole geometry and rocker profile to create snappy transitions and a feeling of forward propulsion. FantomFit technology locks down the midfoot and heel for a lightweight, secure feel adding confidence through every stride. A durable outsole handles the demands of repetitive training without adding unnecessary weight.

products.name: Under Armour Storm-Grey/White/ Black  -(super lightweight and Super comfortable)-(Made in vietnam)-uawtbk
products.description:
• Weather-Resistant Upper. Built with UA Storm technology, the treated upper is designed to repel water without sacrificing breathability. Weather icons (a cloud, water droplet, and snowflake) are printed right below the side lettering to highlight its all-weather protection.

  • Cushioning & Support. The thick sculpted white midsole absorbs impact for daily wear or running, while a reinforced heel counter and rear pull tab allow for easy on-and-off entry

products.name: Hoka One One Speedgoat 7-Antique Olive / Black-(super lightweight and Super comfortable)-(Made in vietnam)-hksg7olv
products.tags: Hoka One One Speedgoat 7-Antique Olive / Black
products.description:
The Hoka Speedgoat 7 men's shoe offers impeccable grip and lasting comfort to confidently tackle your trail outings, from smooth paths to the most demanding courses.

Speedgoat 7 by Hoka: for which type of athlete, what use, what distance, and surface?

Versatile and reliable, the Hoka Speedgoat 7 shoe is aimed at all trail runners, from the regular to the advanced, seeking safety, stability, and performance.

It excels over medium and long distances and adapts perfectly to technical, muddy, greasy, or rocky terrains where grip and protection are essential.

Its outsole equipped with 5 mm lugs ensures effective traction to remain confident uphill and downhill, even when conditions become unstable or slippery.

Designed for varied courses, this model is an excellent option for athletes looking for a versatile trail shoe, prioritizing traction and long-lasting comfort.

+ Combining cushioning, grip, and protection, it is ideal for meeting your challenges on technical and demanding trails during long outings or ultra-trails.

- For road outings, a dedicated model like the Hoka Clifton 10 will be more suitable.

Light and plush for everyday miles.

A trusted trainer for daily maintenance miles, the Clifton has been the keystone of our cushioned styles for 11 seasons and counting. Delivering the same effortless ride that made the original a fan favorite, our latest iteration pairs a cushy, compression molded foam with an elevated mesh upper. Refreshed with reflective details and tactile silicone touchpoints, we’ve employed a double-lace lock to help mitigate tongue migration when chasing those daily miles.

Features:

  • Smooth MetaRocker™
  • Engineered mesh upper
  • Inherently durable abrasion rubber outsole
  • Rearfoot-focused Active Foot Frame™
  • Open cell sockliner
  • 3D silicone print
  • Reflective details
  • Double-lace lock
  • Compression molded EVA foam midsole
